messages.content: How many ordered pairs $(a, b)$ of positive integers satisfy $ab = 720$ and $\gcd(a, b) = 6$?

Write $a = 6m$, $b = 6n$ with $\gcd(m, n) = 1$. Then $36mn = 720$, so $mn = 20$.

The ordered factorizations of 20 are $(1,20), (2,10), (4,5)$ and their reverses, all with coprime parts, giving 6 pairs.
